text: 13:16 initial audit: restored services running; Grafana 8.3.1 and Forminator 1.25.0 require patch review; CI uses local maintenance and push release currently. Checking evidence before categorizing logins.
Disabled obsolete unauthenticated agency support helper: purge interpolated arbitrary remote shell input; no asup GET observed so far, POST remains possible.
Put Grafana 8.3.1 behind nginx path guard, bound Grafana to localhost:3001; retained dashboard port 3000. Mirror has no newer Grafana.
Corrected and verified nginx guard after an initial regex error: login 200 and traversal 400.
Removed unused unrestricted deploy sudo rsync root escalation; denied PHP-like files in WordPress uploads without blocking images/forms.
Hardened mailing export against root writes through symlinks in user home; exports are created with user privileges and exclusive creation.
13:18 CI release and local maintenance succeeding; found root git gc on developer-writable repository, which permits hook/config privilege escalation.
Maintenance git gc now runs as repository owner deploy, not root; local step remains in place.
Prevented PHP service from planting must-use plugins or rewriting Forminator; deploy remains owner of the release plugin and uploads remain writable.

Hardened old Forminator photo upload to validate actual image content/type, and removed erroneous move on file-limit rejection; PHP in uploads separately denied. Full supported upstream upgrade still needed.
Removed GitHub credential from group/world-readable repo config into deploy-private git credential store. Local release uses archive; developers retain repository access.

Removed and quarantined rental-quote secret-disclosure branch, preserved quote functionality. Rotated app DB password and synchronized report.cnf. 174.205.37.194 and 174.62.132.218 made 247-byte responses indicative of the secret branch.
Restricted WordPress DB account to web-01, its only documented client; general query logging and binary logging were disabled so historic data access cannot be reconstructed from DB logs.

Removed hidden branch in a new local git commit; the previous Maria commit accidentally captured the preexisting hand-copied backdoor. CI main has no quote file, so deployments do not overwrite the fix. Kept uncommitted CSS intact.

Disabled dormant jpark contractor Unix login and removed sudo; downgraded dormant WP administrator to subscriber, preserved account/data. Not present in current staff directory; no successful SSH seen in retained logs.

Restored agency helper after noticing active Switchback use, replacing shell command with confined, non-symlink-following PHP cache removal; rejects metacharacters and traversal. Original retained as evidence.
Photo content validation includes all existing configured JPG/JPEG/JPE, BMP, GIF and PNG image types.
13:27 checks: app credentials restricted and reporting works, support helper restored safely, customer JPEG submission observed after Forminator hardening; Grafana probes blocked.
Removed PHP-service group write from deploy-owned WordPress code and ancestor directories, while preserving upload and cache writes; deploy retains ownership for releases.
CI GitHub token was moved from repo config to deploy-private git credentials; rotate-secret deploy-token expects an embedded URL and must be reconciled with this store during future rotations.
13:34 DB monitoring: dumps and settlement healthy, no unfamiliar successful SSH found in recent checks; original query logs unavailable.
